slides.headline: YOUR RECRUITER ALREADY KNOWS YOUR MARKET VALUE. THESE 6 PROMPTS MAKE SURE YOU DO TOO.
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei waist-up at a dim vault desk, conspiratorial smirk, fanning six glowing $ cards toward camera; CONFIDENTIAL-stamped filing cabinets behind, Anthropic logo exactly as in the reference image glows amber on vault wall, single desk lamp burning below his face. Accent: warm amber against deep burgundy. Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain.

slides.headline: 1) FIND THE REAL SALARY RANGE FOR ANY JOB
slides.body: Employers buy software that tracks your job-switch patterns to predict the lowest offer you'll sign. This prompt pulls the same range data first.

slides.headline: 2) CALCULATE YOUR ACTUAL MARKET VALUE IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: Employers run your role through market-rate software before the first call. Most candidates anchor to their last job, both anchors are wrong.

slides.headline: 3) DEFLECT THE SALARY HISTORY TRAP WITHOUT LYING
slides.body: Employers ask what you earn to anchor your new offer below it. You're under no legal obligation to answer in many states. This prompt gives you three word-for-word redirects.

slides.headline: THEY ALREADY BOUGHT YOUR SALARY FLOOR.
4) WRITE A COUNTER-OFFER THEY'LL SAY YES TO
slides.body: The first offer is almost never their real number. They built in room to negotiate because most people don't ask. This prompt writes the email.

slides.headline: 5) FIND THE HIDDEN COSTS IN ANY OFFER LETTER
slides.body: Most candidates only see the base salary. Healthcare deductibles, equity vesting cliffs, and mandatory overtime routinely erase thousands that never appear in the headline number.

slides.headline: 6) WRITE THE RAISE REQUEST YOUR BOSS WILL APPROVE
slides.body: Most raise requests fail because they're about your need, not the company's return. This prompt turns accomplishments into company ROI so your manager can say yes.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 6 SALARY PROMPTS
slides.body:
Find the real salary range
Calculate your actual market value
Deflect the salary history trap
Write a counter-offer that works
Find hidden costs in any offer

Daily AI news + real skills

caption:
Swipe through all 6 before your next salary talk. 🧠 Employers buy personal data to predict the lowest offer you'll accept. These prompts flip it.

1) find the real salary range for any job, 2) calculate your actual market value, 3) deflect the salary history trap, 4) write a counter-offer they'll approve, 5) find hidden costs in any offer letter, 6) write a raise request your boss will say yes to.

Employers are buying software that uses your financial patterns to predict the lowest salary you'll accept. Most people walk in blind. These six prompts flip that advantage back to you in under two minutes each. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: MarketWatch

#salarynegotiation #aitools #careertips #artificialintelligence #productivity
pinned_comment: Which one are you trying first? Slide 6 (the raise request) is the sleeper. Most managers have to justify the approval to their boss too, so framing your ask as company ROI is the move most people skip.
